emails.subject: Pinnacle Study PTX-305: Scheduling of Interim Monitoring Visit (IMV) at Site S-102
emails.body:
Hi Maria,

I hope you are well.

I'm writing to schedule the next Interim Monitoring Visit for the PTX-305 study at your site. I am proposing the week of November 6th, specifically Nov 7th, 8th, or 9th. Please let me know which of these dates works best for you and Dr. Reed.

The primary objectives for this visit will be:
- 100% Source Data Verification (SDV) for the first two FTD patients (S-102-001 and S-102-002)
- Review of the Investigator Site File (ISF)
- Drug accountability review

I have attached a draft agenda for your review. Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,

David Chen
Clinical Research Associate
Pinnacle Therapeutics

emails.subject: Re: Pinnacle Study PTX-305: Scheduling of Interim Monitoring Visit (IMV) at Site S-102
emails.body:
Hi David,

Thanks for reaching out. After checking our calendars, November 8th would work best for us.

We will ensure the patient binders for S-102-001 and S-102-002 are ready for 100% SDV, and the ISF will be up-to-date and available for your review.

The agenda looks fine. Will Dr. Reed need to be available for the entire day, or just for a specific meeting?

Best,

Maria Garcia
Site Coordinator
Oakwood Clinical Research Center

emails.subject: Re: Pinnacle Study PTX-305: Scheduling of Interim Monitoring Visit (IMV) at Site S-102
emails.body:
Hi Maria,

That's great, thank you for confirming. I have booked the visit for Wednesday, November 8th.

Regarding Dr. Reed's availability, I will only need a brief meeting with her at the beginning of the day to discuss the plan and at the end of the day for a debrief on my findings. I anticipate this will be about 30 minutes for each meeting.

I will send the official confirmation letter with the finalized agenda shortly.

Looking forward to seeing you both.

Best regards,

David Chen
Clinical Research Associate
Pinnacle Therapeutics

description: A routine back-and-forth email exchange between the CRA and a Site Coordinator to schedule an upcoming interim monitoring visit. The discussion covers potential dates, confirmation of the agenda (including 100% SDV for the first two FTD patients), and a request to have specific patient binders and ISF documents available for review.
